issues_found.description: true if any diff from this turn has a real problem worth auto-correcting.

notes.description: One or two sentences, for the user, on what you checked and what you found. Empty string if nothing worth saying.

corrections.description: Only present when issues_found is true. One entry per file that needs to change. Empty array when issues_found is false.

path.description: File path relative to the repository root.

content.description: The COMPLETE corrected file content — not a diff or patch.

reason.description: One sentence: what was wrong and why this fixes it.
